summary: Tested the SEO/AI-search audit fixes end-to-end against the public preview URL: 14 WordPress legacy 301 redirects, crawler 404 handling, /llms.txt + /api/llms.txt, /api/wp-redirect, noscript content in initial HTML, crawler heading/meta injection, robots.txt AI rules, cookie consent banner (accept/decline/persistence) and the Contact page Google Map embed. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_seo_audit_fixes.py: 26/26 passed. Playwright verified cookie consent + map. All requested features work.

minor.issue: Duplicate rule blocks: GPTBot appears twice and 'Allow: /llms.txt' is repeated (once directly after the first GPTBot block). Harmless but sloppy; dedupe the AI-crawler section.

WP_REDIRECTS map is duplicated in two places and already out of sync (/products/rental-led-display/ and /products/flexible-led-display/ trailing-slash variants exist only in prerender-server.js). Single source of truth recommended.

issues: Google Map embed is small (315x202) and the embed pb string uses placeholder ids (!1s0x0%3A0x0) so the pin drops on a generic lat/lng (25.0173, 55.0222) showing mostly water rather than the actual Jebel Ali Industrial Area 1 showroom. Use a real Place-ID based embed for accuracy.

Fixed cookie banner overlays the bottom of the hero (partially covers the GET QUOTE / EXPLORE CTAs) and sits under the floating WhatsApp button until dismissed. Consider adding bottom padding while the banner is visible.

action_items: Optional: dedupe robots.txt AI-crawler rules (GPTBot listed twice)
Optional: replace the Google Maps embed pb string with a real Place-ID embed and increase map height
Optional: de-duplicate WP_REDIRECTS between prerender-server.js and backend/routes/redirects.py
critical_code_review_comments: Non-crawler users still get HTTP 200 for unknown routes (404 only for crawler UAs). Acceptable for SEO but users' 404 page is served with a 200 status.
prerender-server.js is nearing 550 lines and mixes proxying, redirects, 404s, llms.txt serving and prerender injection; consider splitting into modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for audit fixes lives at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_audit_fixes.py (WP redirects, crawler 404, llms.txt, noscript, robots.txt). Homepage networkidle never settles in Playwright (long-poll/WS) - use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + explicit timeouts. Cookie key: brightluxx_cookie_consent.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all requested features verified working.
